title: 5d-3: DD forbidden pairs maintained view
description:
## Parent

sutra/68 — 5d PRD: constraint system + DD integration

## What to build

Extend the DD worker's timely dataflow with a second input collection for forbidden `(file_id, file_id)` pairs. Add a maintained view that computes `edges ∩ forbidden_pairs → violations`, replacing the current ad-hoc `query_forbidden_deps` intersection at query time. The `Command` enum gains `SetForbiddenPairs`. Violations are maintained live — they update automatically on both edge changes and forbidden pair changes.

This is the technically novel change. The DD spike demonstrated forbidden deps as a maintained view, but the current engine has a single-input architecture. Reference: `docs/v1-spikes/differential-dataflow.md` on `spike/hdc-ast-encoding`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Second input collection for forbidden pairs
- [ ] `SetForbiddenPairs` command on worker
- [ ] Maintained violation view (edge ∩ forbidden)
- [ ] Incremental on both edge and forbidden-pair changes
- [ ] Old ad-hoc method removed/deprecated
- [ ] Existing cycle + blast radius views unaffected
- [ ] Tests for maintained view behavior

## Blocked by

- sutra/69 — 5d-1: rename dd/ → constraints/

acceptance_criteria.text: ✅ DD worker accepts a second input collection for forbidden pairs via new SetForbiddenPairs command
✅ Maintained view computes edges ∩ forbidden_pairs → violations automatically
✅ Violations update incrementally when edges change (add/remove import)
✅ Violations update when forbidden pairs change (add/remove constraint)
✅ Old query_forbidden_deps ad-hoc method removed or deprecated
✅ Cycle detection and blast radius views unchanged
✅ Incremental update latency stays under 100ms for single-edge changes
✅ Tests cover: set forbidden pairs + ingest matching edge → violation appears, remove edge → violation disappears, change forbidden pairs → violations update
